amendments.reason: Existing recora_operator.operator_command_receipts requires organization_id, while P0 includes global administrator commands.
amendments.decision: admin_command_receipts is the universal P0 receipt; every human command links operator_events, organization/project commands may additionally bridge to the legacy operator receipt, and M02 closes role-assignment authorization evidence for global commands without weakening the legacy receipt contract.

amendments.reason: The fixed P0 relation inventory contains no separate admin outbox attempt table.
amendments.decision: admin_outbox_messages stores mutable delivery projection and monotonic attempt_count; detailed attempts are emitted as system_event after M08. No hidden attempt-history table is introduced in M01.

amendments.reason: An idempotency key alone cannot distinguish a legitimate replay from reuse with different normalized command inputs.
amendments.decision: admin_command_receipts stores a server-computed lowercase SHA-256 request_fingerprint. Future command boundaries return the existing receipt only when the fingerprint matches and reject mismatches as idempotency_conflict.

amendments.reason: master advanced to P4-B account access, adding customer_session actor evidence, invitation/membership RPCs and a customer-safe access projection.
amendments.decision: Rebase the physical design on commit 2c2a6fba70b75e858abc71a7447840bf32f3507d; M00 now verifies the P4-B enum/column/actor constraint/tables/RPC security, M04 reuses that invitation authority, and invitation_expires_at is removed from the planned organization_members extension.
